fields.summary_ko.0: Tesla (TSLA) is trading near the midpoint of its 52-week range, declining $13.31 (-3.34%) after the final trade, with an additional $3.89 decline in after-hours trading.
fields.summary_ko.1: TSLA's total revenue was flat year-over-year and quarter-over-quarter, but net income declined 46.79% year-over-year and 29.48% quarter-over-quarter, with EPS falling at the same rate.
fields.summary_ko.2: TSLA falls into the mega-cap category with a market cap exceeding $200 billion and is a comparison point with automotive industry competitors.
